scope: Independent observations and source-derived estimates for sensitivity analyses of Lipozyme 435 in the pentyl propanoate example.

lorenzo_2025.specimen: Lipozyme 435, Candida antarctica lipase B immobilized on Lewatit VP OC 1600
lorenzo_2025.particle_mean_diameter_locator: Section 2.2 and Figure 2. The measurement protocol uses distilled water and Figure 2 is labelled wet. The text describes the reported diameter on a dry basis. A paired dry and wet distribution was unavailable.

dry_nitrogen_sorption.source: Section 2.2. Author-derived particle porosity using the measured nitrogen-sorption pore volume and adopted density for PMMA. Degassed at 110 °C for 2 h before sorption at −196 °C.

aqueous_tracers.source: Appendix A, Eq. A.5 and Table A1. Author-derived particle porosity from separate blue-dextran and sodium-azide residence-time experiments.

particle_porosity.comparison: These estimates differ in measurement method and fluid. Their ratio supports a porosity-only scenario at fixed molecular diffusivity, tortuosity and constrictivity. Reactive-liquid connected porosity and its change from stirred batch to packed bed were unreported.

effectiveness_factor.provenance: Analytical estimates with tortuosity adopted from a study of waste-cooking-oil free fatty acids and octanol. The estimates provide a source model baseline. Effective diffusivity and effectiveness in the reactive beads were unmeasured.

chaussard_2024.specimen: Commercial Novozym 435 from Strem, made by Novozymes, Candida antarctica lipase B on Lewatit VP OC 1600

diameter_measurement.locator: Supporting Information Section 1, Figures S1–S8, Tables S1–S2
diameter_measurement.method: Manual diameter measurements from optical micrographs with 100 µm scale bars. Dry and wet distributions were measured on separate bead samples within each nominal sieve category.
diameter_measurement.dispersion_statistic: Sample standard deviation of individual bead diameters. The source supplied no uncertainty interval for the wet-to-dry ratio or diffusivity.

reaction_size_comparison.locator: Main article Section 4.3, Table 1 experiments 16–18, Figure 6
reaction_size_comparison.observation: At less than 5% conversion, the observed initial reaction rates differed by up to a factor of two across catalyst sieve fractions in the equimolar ethyl-butyrate and racemic 2-pentanol transesterification.
reaction_size_comparison.inference: The size sensitivity supports testing internal transport. Figure 14 estimates initial effectiveness from 0.70 to 0.37 using assumed porosity 0.50, tortuosity 6 and constrictivity 1. These are model outputs. The study used a different reaction and supplied no measured diffusivity or change from stirred batch to packed bed in the pentyl propanoate system.

chaussard_2024.transfer: Dry-to-wet differences in these analogue liquids support diameter scenarios only. The unsieved wet and dry means come from broad unmatched populations and should serve only as a stress case.

mei_2003.specimen: Commercial Novozyme 435, Candida antarctica lipase B on polymethylmethacrylate resin
mei_2003.method: Synchrotron infrared microspectroscopy of bead cross-sections
mei_2003.observation: Protein was found heterogeneously in an exterior shell of the beads.
mei_2003.transfer: This is a geometric sensitivity for the location of a fixed protein inventory. Active-enzyme distribution, shell wetting and batch-to-bed changes for the target specimens were unmeasured.
